2016_1.question: Which one of the following is not a monitorable target of the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Abhiyan?

options.a: Provide girls' toilet in every school in 100 Child Sex Ratio (CSR) districts by the year 2017
options.b: 100 percent girls' enrolment in secondary education by the year 2020
options.c: Promote a protective environment for girl children through implementation of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO)Act, 2012
options.d: Train Elected Representatives / Grassroot functionanes as Community Champions to mobilize communities to improve CSR and promote girl's education

2016_1.subject: Social Issues

options.a: Improve the overall quality of private educational institutions
options.b: Ensure reforms in the affiliation, academic and examination systems
options.c: Correct regional imbalances in access to higher education
options.d: Create an enabling atmosphere in the higher educational institutions to devote themselves to research and innovations
